Keep this app open. When the TV connects, the buttons start working.

An independent remote app. It is not made by, endorsed by or affiliated with Rosso or any other TV maker.

Full control: Android TV and Google TV.
Other Smart TVs: some functions only (often volume, YouTube and Netflix).
Bluetooth mode: for TVs that accept a Bluetooth keyboard or remote.

The app talks to your TV only over your own Wi‑Fi or Bluetooth. It is free and shows ads.
